test_title: PYST 28: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The mice were chased by the cat.

options.text: The cat is chasing the mice.
The cat are chased the mice.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**The cat chased the mice**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Passive Voice**: "The mice were chased by the cat."
 
• **Structure**: Subject (The mice) + Verb (were chased) + Object (by the cat)</u&
